Text & settings

Narration

No music track chosen yet
Plays under the voice for the whole video: it loops if it is shorter and fades out over the last second.
Word sync
Free, and runs on this device: the first time, the browser downloads the speech recogniser once and keeps it. The audio never leaves this device.
How far down the screen each word arrives as it is spoken (percent of the frame height from the top).
On a computer you can also drag the zone, or its edges, in the preview.
0 = tight snap: each line jumps into the zone as its first word is spoken. Anything above 0 is a continuous glide; the higher, the smoother and steadier the flow (85 is the default), with words landing a little less exactly on the voice.
Positive = words arrive a little before they are spoken; negative = a little after. A built-in 0.3 s delay is already applied on top of this, so the text starts with the first spoken word.
Timing
Word sync is steering the crawl, so the crawl length and speed controls are paused. Turn off “Sync words to speech” to use them. “Audio starts at” still adds a lead-in before the voice.
Timing mode
Seconds of crawl before the voice begins. The audio plays at normal speed, never stretched.
Choose the .timings.json that came with the stitched audio and the Reader uses its exact first and last spoken moments.
Positive = text finishes after the voice ends; negative = text finishes earlier.
Text
Up to 200 px, more than double the old limit. Very large text means fewer words per line and a longer crawl.
Uses the real OpenDyslexic Bold face.
Defaults to solid black.
Crawl shape & edges
0% is the classic straight-line crawl. Higher values keep the text rising straight and full width through the middle, then bend it away sharply near the top. Crawl length shifts a little because the path changes.
On: every word stands up and shrinks evenly with distance (no squashed, flattened letters). Off: the classic look, where the letters lie flat on the tilted plane.
A soft shadow under every word, cast onto the tilted plane. It shrinks with the letters as they recede.
Where the light comes from: 0° from the right, 90° from the top, 180° from the left, 270° from the bottom. The shadow falls the opposite way. Drag the dial or use the slider.
Mid-grey shows up on black; pick a darker colour on light backgrounds.
How early the text dissolves as it recedes. 0% is a hard cut at the vanishing point; the finish time does not change.
Fades text in as it rises from the bottom of the frame. 0% is no fade.

Saves your current look, landing zone, sync, timing, crawl shape, export and backing-volume settings on this device, and uses them every time the page opens. Your text, audio and file names are never saved. Shadow settings aren’t included.

Drive only: select the main folder KJB Rolling Reader Finished clips itself, NOT a subfolder inside it (such as “untitled folder”). Only that exact folder is accepted. No device download. Sign-in also asks to read Drive metadata for filename checks (no file contents). This browser remembers sign-in until the access token expires (about 1 hour), then tries to renew quietly if you are still signed into Google. Google may still need a popup: if blocked, click Sign in again. If browser storage is blocked, sign-in is only for this tab. A waiting finished MP4 is only held in this tab’s memory until Drive confirms upload; closing or refreshing can lose it.
